caption: The drawing consists of several outlined shapes and figures in a light blue or grayish pencil on a yellowed piece of paper. The shapes are organized within a large rectangular border, most of them being irregular, geometric, or rounded, and include both large and small components. The largest piece, located in the upper left quadrant, appears curved and bulbous, labeled "B-1." Surrounding it are other shapes, including a blocky, angular form in the upper center, a small rounded triangle to its right, and a thin rectangular strip at the top and another thin, elongated rectangle at the bottom. Below the main shapes are various smaller rectangles and curved pieces, each labeled with writing, numbers, and occasionally the word "FOLD." There are dotted lines, arrows, and handwritten notes in English scattered throughout the drawing, along with measurement notations and segment markers denoted by different letters such as "A," "B," "C," "D," and "F." The entire drawing is set against an off-white or beige background with some small areas of discoloration and minor spotting, indicating age.
title: Girl's Dress (Pattern)
